superseded_by_methodology.reason: The originally frozen 14-month sample was judged too short before any market-data load or result was observed.

SOLUSDT's public daily and 5-minute archives are both missing 2022-02-26..02-28 and 2022-04-01..04-02 (confirmed: ETHUSDT and BNBUSDT have zero gaps across the full 2021-04-05..2026-09-01 range, checked exhaustively before any signal or result was computed). The strict execution-continuity check in simulate_xsm_pairs has no gap-tolerance option by design (it deliberately refuses to replay fills across missing bars), so the development window start moves from 2021-04-05 to the next Monday after the gap, 2022-04-04, rather than patching or interpolating the missing candles.
